```sql
SELECT 
    DATE(CreaionDate) AS post_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_new_questions
FROM main."posts"
WHERE PostTypeId = 1
  AND CreaionDate >= '2013-06-01' 
  AND CreaionDate < '2013-07-01'
GROUP BY DATE(CreaionDate)
ORDER BY post_date;
```
